phoneJustOn: The phone has just started (it was off for {how}). Messages that arrived meanwhile may not be notified again: look at the message pages of the apps on it, and phone wx_chats lists WeChat chats left unanswered
netCatchup: New messages of this stretch may not have been notified: phone wx_chats lists WeChat chats left unanswered (and whether someone @-ed you in a group); look at the other apps' message pages too
netBack: {tag} The phone was offline for about {mins} minutes (from around {hm}: {why}); {how}. {catchup}
netTriedAuto: automatic repair has been trying for a while without success
netTodoAuto: phone net shows the details; tell {owner} if it stays down
netTriedBoth: neither toggling wifi nor rebooting the phone fixed it
netTodoBoth: phone net shows the details; tell {owner} (the computer itself may be offline, or the emulator is broken)
netTriedWifi: toggling wifi did not fix it; the phone was not rebooted automatically this time (you were just using it, or it was rebooted within the last half hour)
netTodoWifi: when you are done with the phone, run phone net --fix (it reboots the phone, a minute or two)
netFail: [phone offline·needs you] The phone has been offline since around {hm}, about {mins} minutes now ({why}); {tried}. No app on it receives messages right now. {todo}
noLoadCommand: there is no load command (the load guard is not turned on)
phoneNotStarted: {at} did not start the phone automatically: {why}
lineCut: … (cut here, it was too long; read the whole of it yourself)
busyDropStale: The senses are busy; run --drop-stale again in a moment
droppedStale: dropped {n} pending item(s) that had been raised {times} times
ackBusy: The acknowledgement was not recorded (the senses are busy); run --ack again in a few seconds
budgetStale: (it cannot be read this time; below are the old figures of {at})
budgetPace: Pace of the week: by now {p}% should be used, and {week}% is: {gap}
budgetPerDay: On average you can use {points:.1f} points a day from here (7-day window)
budgetToday: Spent today (since 04:00): {t} points of the 7-day window
pulseBehind: Quota is being wasted: the 7-day window is at {week}%, the pace says {p}% ({points:.0f} points behind)
pulseBehindTodo: Push your goals: hand work from them to Claude Code, or do it yourself. Keep 15–20% of the 5h window for talking with {owner}.
pulseAhead: Quota is burning too fast: the 7-day window is at {week}%, the pace says {p}% ({diff:.0f} points ahead)
pulseAheadTodo: Stop what is not urgent first: wake less in free time, start no new big Claude Code task, fewer sub-agents. Talking with {owner} is not affected.
quotaIdleText: Only {used}% of Claude's 5-hour quota is used and it resets at {at}; what is not used is lost
quotaIdleBody:
Claude (your own account), 5-hour window: {used}% used, resets at {at} ({minutes} minutes left); 7-day window {week}%.
What is not used before the reset is lost. Look at your goals and at what you want to do: hand what Claude Code can do to it (helper send; for something big, two or three sessions at once), or carry on with what you have in hand. Keep a little room for talking with {owner}. If there is nothing you want to do right now, that is fine too: just ack it.
quotaNightText: Nearly 01:00: before you sleep, give Claude Code something that can run through the night
quotaNightBody: You rest from 01:00 to 08:00, but Claude's quota window resets in the night all the same, and an empty one is lost. Before you sleep, think: among your goals and the things you want to do, is there something Claude Code can run by itself overnight (research, code, material, tidying up…)? Say clearly what you want and what counts as done, and have it stop and wait for you when it is done; the result stays in the session, and you check it when you wake in the morning. {week}If there is nothing you want to hand over, that is fine too: just ack it.
remindOwnBody: This is a reminder you set for yourself%s (it is not from %s): %s
budgetUsage:
My quota ledger: I meter my own tokens, to use the plan fully without burning a week in a day.

  budget snap        read the quota once (a real reading at most every 15 minutes, the cache otherwise) and record it in memory/budget/snaps.jsonl
  budget status      how things stand: how much of 5h/7d is used, when they reset, whether the week runs ahead or behind, what today cost, who was running when
  budget pulse       for the senses: one JSON line that wakes me when the week runs far behind (wasted) or far ahead (burning too fast)
  budget day [date]  the account of a day: usage at its start and end, what each hour cost, the Claude Code sessions running then

How it reads: a tiny Haiku request, taking utilization and resetsAt of five_hour / seven_day from the rate_limit_event (no big model is called).
remindUsage:
Reminders (HH has its own remind tool for setting them).

  remind fire --text words [--set time]   called by a scheduled job when the time has come: puts the reminder in the queue and has the senses look at once
  remind due                              the senses' remind source: lists the reminders that came due in the last day
senseNote.quota: Claude's 5-hour quota resets soon with a lot left / the reminder before sleep to hand out night work
senseNote.budget: the weekly quota is behind its pace (going to waste) or ahead of it (burning too fast)
senseNote.remind: a reminder a scheduled job put in is due
